messages:
arjun: Quick sanity check — ran a brief holdback: nova10b-int6 vs nova10b-int8 with an int8 reranker. Want routing recommendation for low-risk vs sensitive routes. Numbers below, pls scan.

maya: TL;DR: int6 saves ~32% token cost, p95 latency +12ms, quality drop ~1.8% absolute on our chat QA set (n=1,200). More below.

tess: Nice. What dataset exactly? production traffic sample or synthetic prompts?

maya: Mixed set — 1,200 prompts: 60% customer snippets (anonymized), 40% internal QA + edge cases. Metric = EM (exact match) + chrF for fuzzier stuff. Reranker is 13b-int8 applied to candidate list.

maya: Eval table (quick paste):
```
model               | cost_per_1k_tokens | p95_ms | EM_delta 
nova10b-int8        | $4.20              | 220    | 0.0      
nova10b-int6 (int6) | $2.86              | 232    | -1.8     
```

maya: Throughput: int8 ~450 tok/s per GPU, int6 ~520 tok/s (quantized kernel wins on throughput). Token econ win mostly from per-token throughput + smaller memory.

eva: Are there specific routes we should exclude? search/billing are latency/accuracy sensitive.

arjun: Good call. Product requirement: any route serving billing or retrieval QA must have EM_loss <= 0.5 abs. Everything else is negotiable.

ryan: From product POV — 1.8% absolute on QA for visible answers is high; would cause support noise. We can tolerate up to 0.7% degradation for background features.

tess: Ops suggestion: try a mixed routing flag — serve 20% traffic to int6 for exploration, keep 80% on int8, keep reranker on int8 for all candidates. Add metric gates and automated rollback if EM drops below -1.0 for 24h.

arjun: Proposed rollout plan:
- Create route `nova10b-int6-explore` weight=20%
- Keep default on nova10b-int8
- Reranker stays on 13b-int8 for both arms
- Gate metrics: EM_delta, p95 latency, token_cost_per_1k
- Rollback if EM_delta < -1.0 for 24h or p95 increase > +30ms

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created rollout `nova10b-int6-explore` (20%) — canary started at 1738000005.

maya: I'll attach the eval notebook and raw CSV to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/ML/notes/ND-482 (internal link). Also adding subset where reranker confidence <0.7 — most regressions come from low-confidence completions.

tess: Good call to gate on reranker confidence. Proposal: for queries where reranker_confidence < 0.7, always route to int8; else allow int6. That reduces visible regressions.

arjun: Updated plan: 20% explore but enforce: if reranker_conf < 0.7 -> force int8. Also metric-gate window 48h for more signal on rare cases.

eva: Monitoring checklist?
- EM rolling window (24h, 48h)
- p95 latency by route
- token consumption and cost by customer tier
- alert if EM drop concentrated by customer org

arjun: I'll create the runbook and the PR for routing flags. If we see EM loss >1.0 concentrated in any customer -> immediate rollback.

ryan: Product OK with 20% explore + confidence gating + 2-week canary for business routes. If safe, we'll promote to 50% then full.

maya: Will run extended A/B (48h) and post final numbers here.

arjun: Thanks all — will follow up with rollout PR and runbook. :thumbsup:

tess: :thumbsup:
